questions.prompt: The desire of ruling drove the ambitious general to war.
questions.answer: Cupiditās dominandī ducem ambitiōsum ad bellum impulit.

questions.prompt: Man is born for acting, not for resting lazily.
questions.answer: Homō ad agendum, nōn ad ignāvē quiēscendum, nātus est.

questions.prompt: This clear water is useful for drinking.
questions.answer: Haec aqua candida bibendō ūtilis est.

questions.prompt: By reading much the young man perfected the art of speaking.
questions.answer: Multum legendō adulēscēns artem dīcendī perfēcit.

questions.prompt: Desirous of hearing, the crowd fell silent when the poet rose.
questions.answer: Audiendī cupida, turba conticuit cum poēta exsurrēxit.

questions.prompt: At first light we entered the maritime temple for the sake of praying.
questions.answer: Prīmā lūce templum maritimum ōrandī grātiā intrāvimus.

questions.prompt: The mind is strengthened by thinking and weakened by sleeping.
The difficult art of writing well is learned quickly by no one.
questions.answer: Difficilis ars bene scrībendī ā nūllō celeriter discitur.
